args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Modify the ExportButton to remember the last selected export format using local storage. This change will prevent the export format from defaulting to CSV each time and enhance user experience by retaining their last selected choice.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `ExportButton` component defaults to "csv" for the export format. This enhancement will allow the component to remember and default to the last selected export format using local storage, improving user experience by avoiding the need to select the export format each time.
